scenarios.prompt: REP: 'Looking at your Total Bill and Amount Paid: do you have an Itemized Bill and Proof of Payment ready?'

option_pool.text: Yes, I have BOTH the Itemized Bill and Proof of Payment.
I have the Itemized Bill, but NO Proof of Payment receipt.
I have Proof of Payment, but NO Itemized Bill yet.
I have NEITHER an Itemized Bill nor Proof of Payment yet.

scenarios.right_reply: REP: 'Thank you for the accurate billing breakdown—I've logged your exact invoice and receipt status.'
scenarios.wrong_reply: REP: 'Hmm, what you have on file doesn't match what you just reported for your itemized bill or receipt.'

scenarios.prompt: REP: 'Before we finalize the balance, do you have any Other Insurance Coverage (secondary plan) to coordinate?'

option_pool.text: Yes, I have dual/other insurance coverage to coordinate.
No, this is my sole insurance policy (no other coverage).
Ask the rep to bill every insurer twice just in case.

scenarios.right_reply: REP: 'Got it! Coordination of benefits is logged accurately.'
scenarios.wrong_reply: REP: 'Check your billing notes—your secondary insurance status doesn't match!'
